looks_and_drafts.label: Looks & drafts
looks_and_drafts.ifYouNeverTouchThis: Pax answers, researches and drafts whenever you ask. This is never gated, never counted, and keeps working while paused.

changes_records.label: Changes your records
changes_records.ifYouNeverTouchThis: When you ask Pax to change something, it does it and leaves a receipt. Scheduled prompts you set up do the same. Switch to 'Ask before everything' and every change waits for your tap instead.

sends.label: Sends to people
sends.ifYouNeverTouchThis: Pax never sends what it wrote without your tap. Always. There is no setting that changes this.

PAX_LABELS.fixedRule: Anything Pax writes to another person — email, text, letter, payment link — waits for your tap. Always.
mentalModel: Pax looks things up and writes drafts on its own, and it keeps your records up to date — lead status, tasks, deals, calendar, scores — showing you every change.
Pax never sends a message to anyone until you tap Approve; everything waiting for you is in one place, "Waiting for your tap".
Rules you turned on — drips, workflows, scheduled prompts — run by themselves on your own connected accounts, each behind its own switch, and one red button pauses all of it.
PAX_LABELS.youStartOn: You start on Ask before sending. Change it, or pause everything, any time under Settings → Pax.
PAX_LABELS.expiredAsk: Expired — ask Pax to draft it again
PAX_LABELS.noSendingIdentity: no sending identity connected → Settings → BYOK
PAX_LABELS.notRunnable: This can't be run from a tap. Ask Pax to draft it again.

PAX_LIMIT_COPY.title: Daily limits
PAX_LIMIT_COPY.intro: Cap how much Pax may do in one day. Leave a box blank for no limit. When Pax reaches a cap it stops and tells you; nothing is cut short halfway.
PAX_LIMIT_COPY.resetNote: Counts start again at midnight in your workspace's time zone.

labels.asksPerDay: Asks Pax may put in front of you
labels.creditSpendPerDay: Credits Pax's approved sends may cost
labels.batchRowsPerDay: Records Pax may add in a batch

PAX_LIMIT_COPY.adminHint: Ask an owner to change the daily limits.

refusals.asks: Pax has reached your daily limit for asks, so this wasn't done. Your count starts again at midnight, or you can raise the limit under Settings → Pax.
refusals.credits: This send would take Pax past your daily limit for credits, so it wasn't put in front of you. Your count starts again at midnight, or you can raise the limit under Settings → Pax.
refusals.browse: Pax has reached your daily limit for opening web pages, so the page wasn't opened. Your count starts again at midnight, or you can raise the limit under Settings → Pax.
refusals.batchRows: Adding these records would take Pax past your daily limit for batch additions, so none of them were added. Your count starts again at midnight, or you can raise the limit under Settings → Pax.

deniedLine.asks: Stopped at the daily limit for asks
deniedLine.credits: Stopped at the daily limit for credits
deniedLine.browse: Stopped at the daily limit for web pages
deniedLine.batchRows: Stopped at the daily limit for batch additions

PAX_LIMIT_COPY.memberIntro: Make Pax more careful when it acts for you. These can only narrow what the workspace allows — a choice that is wider than the workspace's has no effect.
PAX_LIMIT_COPY.memberLimitNote: A number above the workspace's limit has no effect; the smaller one always applies.
PAX_LIMIT_COPY.memberApplies: What applies to you right now
PAX_LIMIT_COPY.resetWhat: Resets every rail to its starting level, removes every daily limit, and clears everyone's own narrower settings.
PAX_LIMIT_COPY.resetWhatNot: Does not change your stance, the three switches, or a pause.
PAX_LIMIT_COPY.resetDone: Rails, limits and everyone's narrower settings reset

PAX_MY_SITES_COPY.title: My county sites
PAX_MY_SITES_COPY.intro: Public sites you want Pax to search for you — a county assessor, recorder or treasurer. Pax types your search into the site's own search box and reads the results page.
PAX_MY_SITES_COPY.limitLine: Listing a site lets Pax run searches on it. It does not let Pax copy a site's data in bulk: Pax still adds only a few records from a web page at a time, and notes where each one came from.
PAX_MY_SITES_COPY.empty: No sites yet. Add the ones you use and Pax can search them when you ask.
PAX_MY_SITES_COPY.notAddress: That does not look like a website address. Paste the address of the site, like https://assessor.example.gov.
PAX_MY_SITES_COPY.alreadyListed: That site is already on your list.
PAX_MY_SITES_COPY.readOnly: Ask an owner to change your sites.

PAX_PAGE_COPY.title: Pax
PAX_PAGE_COPY.intro: When Pax asks, what runs on its own, and one button that pauses all of it.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.pauseOptionLiftNote: 30 days at most — it lifts by itself if you forget.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.resumeNotYours: An owner, an admin, or the person who paused can resume.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.askAnOwner: Ask an owner to change this
PAX_PAGE_COPY.runsOnItsOwnIntro: Each has its own switch. Pause stops all of them.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.scheduledPromptsEmpty: No scheduled prompts yet — schedule one from the Pax chat.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.runHistoryIntro: The last 20 runs of this prompt.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.inboxDrafts: Draft a reply when I open a message
PAX_PAGE_COPY.inboxDraftsLine: a draft is not an action — nothing is sent until you send it
PAX_PAGE_COPY.canUseIntro: Your own accounts — your keys, your invoices. Pax sends from these, never from an AcreOS address.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.waitingHint: Everything Pax wrote for someone else, in one place.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.receiptsEmpty: Nothing yet. When Pax changes a record or a rule runs, it shows up here.
PAX_PAGE_COPY.teamLink: Who on your team can ask Pax to do what

PAX_PAUSE_COPY.checkFailedRefusal: Pax could not verify its pause setting, so this wasn't done. Try again or check Settings → Pax.

PAX_PAUSE_STILL_WORKS: Pax still answers and drafts, still asks, and anything you approve still goes out.

PAX_RAIL_COPY.title: What Pax may do on each kind of record
PAX_RAIL_COPY.intro: Your stance above still decides first. These rails can only make Pax more careful for one kind of record — never less careful than your stance.

watch.label: Watch
watch.sentence: Pax looks but does not change anything.

draft.label: Draft
draft.sentence: Pax prepares the change and holds it for you. Nothing is written until you tap.

ask.label: Ask
ask.sentence: Pax proposes each change and waits for your tap.

act_and_report.label: Act and report
act_and_report.sentence: Pax makes the change and leaves a receipt.

PAX_RAIL_COPY.sendsCeiling: Sends never go past Ask. Pax never sends what it wrote without your tap.
PAX_RAIL_COPY.alwaysOnLine: Always on — never gated, and it keeps working while paused.
PAX_RAIL_COPY.runsRulesLine: Not a rail. Each rule keeps its own switch, listed under what runs on its own below.
